title: Looking for some beta testers for my game
author: Smart-Sector-3480
selftext:
Hi mates,

Yesterday i managed to almost finish my first game ever created in unity.

The game is a 3d horror game about how to play hide and seek alone with a hunted doll in your house.  
The game is almost finish,i have to create the main menu to make it more attractive and don't know if it need some more jumpscares or not.

This is why i need some testers for my game,also to tell me if i can sell something like this or not.  
The game now is on itch posted for free.  
Who want to play test can contact me and if community want i will edit this post with the link of the game on itch.

Thank you and please notice that i use unity for only almost 30 days now :)
